premises: AlNbTiZr MEA coatings with ~10 at.% Al form a dense oxide layer of Nb2Zr6O17 and ZrO2
This oxide layer provides the best corrosion resistance and minimum oxygen penetration depth
The coating can be deposited by RF magnetron co-sputtering on zirconium alloy substrates
The selected elements (Al, Nb, Ti, Zr) are suitable for nuclear applications due to low neutron absorption and oxide-forming ability
